summary.intent: Ship WP H (managed prerelease, trail #457): move H's two local commits onto a fresh branch off origin/main (now containing merged G), retire E318 so release PRs run whole pre cycles, pass the full gate, and open a PR.
summary.outcome: Partway through: feat/managed-prerelease was created and both H commits were cherry-picked and signed, with docs conflicts resolved against main. The lifecycle test was parametrized over Changesets v2 and v3 pre state and both pass. A changeset was written and docs/releasing.md reorganized, but the final commit is unconfirmed. The gate (just targets, mutants, reviewer), push and PR are not done.

repo: `callisto pre enter` writes Changesets v2 pre state. v3 state (`{"mode":"pre","tag":"beta"}`, applied notes moved to `.changeset/pre/`) has to be hand-written in tests.
E318 retirement touches docs/errors.md (retired-codes list plus table row) and docs/specs/release.json (the `release-pr decide` failure-cases text).
The pre-cycle paragraph in docs/releasing.md belongs under "Release PR and approval", after the CODEOWNERS sentence, and must not split the stale-PR recovery paragraph.
Real-binary lifecycle tests live in crates/callisto-cli/tests/release_pr_pre_cycle_tests.rs and share helpers in tests/common/release_harness.rs.
Commits are GPG-signed, and the signing agent is unreachable from inside the sandbox, so commits must be retried outside it.

code.finding: The single lifecycle test was split into v2 and v3 wrappers that call a shared `prerelease_cycle(enter: impl Fn(&Path))`. The commit steps now use `git add -A` then `commit -m` so the untracked `.changeset/pre/` files are included.

workflow: `git switch -c <branch> origin/main` can leave HEAD unmoved when the upstream-config write fails in the sandbox. Check `git branch --show-current`, then use `git symbolic-ref HEAD` to repair it.
During a cherry-pick conflict, `checkout --ours` discards the non-conflicting hunks of that commit too. Re-apply those hunks by hand and verify against `git show <sha> -- <files>`.
$CARGO_BUILD_JOBS did not hold the intended value from the inline sysctl expression, so it was set explicitly to 4 with `export`. Capture exit codes with zsh `${pipestatus[1]}` when piping to tail.
Run `cargo fmt --all` before committing, since the first commit attempt was redone after formatting.

friction: The first `git switch -c` left HEAD detached from the new branch, which forced a manual symbolic-ref fix and a cherry-pick --quit and retry.
Cherry-pick conflicts in docs/errors.md and docs/specs/release.json were over-resolved by `--ours` and needed a second manual pass.
GPG signing failed inside the sandbox, so the commit had to be retried outside it.
The CARGO_BUILD_JOBS computation (cores/4) did not take effect and was hardcoded to 4.
The docs paragraph was first placed at the wrong spot, splitting the stale-PR recovery paragraph, and had to be moved.
open_items: Confirm the final test commit landed after `cargo fmt`; the commit output was not shown.
Run the full gate by exit code: just pre-push, lint, doc-check, test and ci.
Run `cargo mutants --in-place --in-diff` on the Rust diff with zero missed mutants, and do not commit mutants.out*.
Run one fresh Opus reviewer subagent given only the diff and the goal.
Check that the changeset was made through `callisto add` as asked; it was hand-written to .changeset/silent-ravens-climb.md.
Merge the latest origin/main, push to refs/heads/feat/managed-prerelease, verify with git ls-remote, and open the PR with `entire trail ci-pr` linking trail #457.
Report the PR number and gate results to the lead session (close-gap-for-alpha).
